candidates.name: CHANGE TARGET LAYER
candidates.definition: Before planning a requested change, distinguish which layer is intended to change: world state, signal state, observer perception, observer belief, or observer behavior.
candidates.application_guard: Do not infer that a user wants deception merely because a perception or belief layer is mentioned. Preserve the requested wording, actor view, alternatives and evidence status.

candidates.name: INSTRUMENTAL TRIGGER != TERMINAL GOAL
candidates.definition: When a condition or trigger appears to enable, block, justify or redirect an outcome, test whether that trigger is only one means/path rather than the declared terminal end.
candidates.application_guard: Do not replace the user's stated end with an inferred end. Represent alternative end hypotheses and keep unresolved motive open.

promotion_rule: Repeated cross-domain support plus R-F-R plus explicit review is required before any candidate can become a native/canonical reasoning parameter or rubric.
